name: v21.2.3
body:
## [21.2.3](https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/compare/v21.2.2...v21.2.3) (2026-09-19)

### Bug Fixes

* fix(types): correct breaking-change-exclamation-mark rule config type by @lazerg in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4954
* fix(config-nx-scopes): read scopes from the nx project graph by @dylanpulver in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4957
* fix(lint): trim trailing whitespace off the message handed to ignore matchers by @dylanpulver in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4960
* fix(load): detect dynamic await support on node majors above 20 by @dylanpulver in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4961
* fix(rules): report the case that matched in case rule failure messages by @dylanpulver in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4962
* fix(load): run the parser factory of scoped conventional-changelog presets by @maximilliangrand in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4968



### Refactor

* refactor(load): drop the node version check gating cosmiconfig loaders by @dylanpulver in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4972

### Chore, ci, build, etc.

* build: install pnpm via npm instead of corepack by @escapedcat in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4948
* build: retire the docker compose dev environment by @escapedcat in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4949
* build: verify pnpm tarball against the packageManager sha512 pin by @escapedcat in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4952
* ci: stabilize Windows CI by raising Vitest default timeout by @escapedcat with @Copilot in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4959
* docs: drop the Node 24 config-loading workaround note by @escapedcat in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4976
* chore: move pnpm settings from .npmrc to pnpm-workspace.yaml by @escapedcat in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4977
* chore: swap pnpm resolutionMode time-based for minimumReleaseAge by @escapedcat in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4984

## New Contributors
* @lazerg made their first contribution in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4954
* @escapedcat with @Copilot made their first contribution in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4959
* @dylanpulver made their first contribution in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4957
* @maximilliangrand made their first contribution in https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/pull/4968

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/compare/v21.2.2...v21.2.3
